turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of your class. Nobody called me first, so start there.
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
Which three? And did you read them before you entered the zero, or after?
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
That's not a question about the essay, Hale. Answer mine first: did you read those three before or after the zero went in?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
Don't manage me. You still haven't answered: before or after the zero?
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
Then why are we here? Before or after, Hale.
